title: Workstation skill and toolchain audit keep one mise version per tool
body:
Operator 2026-11-19: one mise version per tool on the host, the newest stable; projects pin the same; durable rule in the workstation skill plus a read-only audit command.
Outcome: the audit exits 0 with 'toolchain PASS' on a clean host and exits 1 with 'toolchain FAIL' listing pin drift, outdated pins, PATH duplicates and multiple installed versions; the workstation skill is in .agents/skills and linked from ~/.claude/skills and ~/.agents/skills.
Proof: node --test test of the audit on fixture mise output and a real run printed in the PR body.
